name: Makindi Empire
description: The ancient empire of which Tazeem was once part; its reign ended when Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave.

description_citations.text: "Tazeem". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Makindi Empire crumbled, the Kargan tribes mastered Akoum's dragons and rode them to victory over the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor

citation.text: "Akoum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A sea monster, perhaps Lorthos, drags the Murasa Skyclave into the sea, ending the Makindi reign.
timeline.quote: dragged the Murasa Skyclave into the sea

citation.text: "Murasa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archangel Iona destroys the Tazeem Skyclave, ending the Makindi reign and creating Emeria.
timeline.quote: The Makindi reign ended when the archangel Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave
